*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/libavcodec/riscv/h264pred_init_riscv.c
@@
-#include "libavutil/attributes.h"
-#include "libavutil/cpu.h"
-#include "libavutil/riscv/cpu.h"
-
-#include "libavcodec/h264pred.h"
+/*
+ * RISC-V H.264 intra prediction init
+ *
+ * Fixes:
+ * 1) -Wmissing-prototypes: provide an explicit prototype.
+ * 2) AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV not available in some trees: map to the RISC-V V flag
+ *    when present or disable RVV dispatch otherwise.
+ */
+
+#include "libavutil/attributes.h"
+#include "libavutil/cpu.h"
+#include "libavutil/riscv/cpu.h"
+
+#include "libavcodec/h264pred.h"
+
+#ifndef AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV
+#if defined(AV_CPU_FLAG_RISCV_V)
+#define AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV AV_CPU_FLAG_RISCV_V
+#else
+#define AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV 0
+#endif
+#endif
+
+av_cold void ff_h264_pred_init_riscv(H264PredContext *h, int codec_id);
@@
-av_cold void ff_h264_pred_init_riscv(H264PredContext *h, int codec_id)
-{
-    int flags = av_get_cpu_flags();
-
-    if (flags & AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV) {
-        /* RVV function pointers assignments... */
-    }
-}
+av_cold void ff_h264_pred_init_riscv(H264PredContext *h, int codec_id)
+{
+    int flags = av_get_cpu_flags();
+
+    if (!(flags & AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV))
+        return;
+
+    /*
+     * RVV-optimized function assignments would go here.
+     * Keep as a no-op stub when building without RVV implementations.
+     */
+    (void)h;
+    (void)codec_id;
+}
*** End Patch
